title: GFCI Adapter Outlet with Automatic Reset
description_html:
Advanced Ground Fault Protection for Pop-Up Countertop Outlets

The GFCI01 GFCI Adapter Outlet with Automatic Reset delivers essential electrical safety for pop-up outlets installed near water sources in kitchens, wet bars, and food preparation areas. While many contemporary electrical circuits incorporate GFCI protection at the breaker panel, this compact 15-amp adapter provides an additional safeguard when you need absolute confidence in your workspace electrical safety. Designed specifically for use with countertop pop-up outlets, it offers UL-listed protection that meets rigorous North American safety standards.

Intelligent Protection Where You Need It Most

Kitchen countertop outlets face unique challenges—moisture from sinks, wet hands, and splashing liquids create potential ground fault hazards. This GFCI adapter outlet installs directly between your pop-up outlet and the wall socket beneath your countertop, continuously monitoring electrical current for dangerous imbalances. When it detects a ground fault condition, it immediately interrupts power to prevent shock hazards. What sets this adapter apart is its automatic reset capability: after tripping, simply cut power to the circuit for ten seconds, and the device automatically restores protection when electricity returns. This intelligent feature proves invaluable when your pop-up outlet sits in hard-to-access locations behind drawers or deep under countertops, eliminating the need to crawl underneath and manually press reset buttons.

Key Features

  • 15-amp capacity suitable for standard kitchen countertop pop-up outlets
  • Automatic reset functionality—restores protection when power cycles
  • Manual reset button accessible for traditional reset operation
  • UL-listed certification ensuring compliance with North American electrical safety standards
  • Compact adapter design fits discreetly beneath countertops
  • Ground fault circuit interrupter protection against electrical shock hazards
  • Designed for indoor use with pop-up outlet systems

Installation & Setup

Installing your GFCI adapter outlet requires no special tools or electrical expertise. Simply plug the adapter into the existing wall socket located beneath your countertop, then connect your pop-up outlet's power cord to the adapter's receptacle. The device immediately begins monitoring for ground faults. For optimal safety, verify proper operation by pressing the test button after installation. Remember that this adapter is engineered exclusively for indoor applications and should never be used outdoors or in weather-exposed locations. If you're uncertain whether your existing circuit already includes GFCI protection, this adapter provides reassuring backup safety at an affordable price point.
